verdict.rationale: The evidence documents RBAC for users and an MCP server that gives agents Admin API access, but nothing shows that Flagsmith can issue scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. User RBAC and the public client-side Environment Key are adjacent features, not scoped agent credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
